f826c09b9c8d90374184cf913d37922c.overview: In 1970s Mexico City, two domestic workers help a mother of four while her husband is away for an extended period of time.
f826c09b9c8d90374184cf913d37922c.tagline: There are periods in history that scar societies and moments in life that transform us as individuals.

f86a5dafcd1180116bcf0895dbfb1b5d.overview: An English-German filmmaking couple retreat to Fårö for the summer to each write screenplays for their upcoming films in an act of pilgrimage to the place that inspired Ingmar Bergman. As the summer and their screenplays advance, the lines between reality and fiction start to blur against the backdrop of the Island's wild landscape.

f8708cab9675f2844386c8d64350410c.overview: Loner Mark Lewis works at a film studio during the day and, at night, takes racy photographs of women. Also he's making a documentary on fear, which involves recording the reactions of victims as he murders them. He befriends Helen, the daughter of the family living in the apartment below his, and he tells her vaguely about the movie he is making.
f8708cab9675f2844386c8d64350410c.tagline: What made this the most diabolical murder weapon ever used?

f89526ae8765669926b9118cd3f116a5.overview: Virgil Starkwell is intent on becoming a notorious bank robber. Unfortunately for Virgil and his not-so-budding career, he is completely incompetent.

f8ccc34cfcdbc7074024a5fdae5d6eff.overview: Just north of London live Wendy, Andy, and their twenty-something twins, Natalie and Nicola. Wendy clerks in a shop, Andy is a cook who forever puts off home remodeling projects, Natalie is a plumber and Nicola is jobless. This film is about how they interact and play out family, conflict and love.

f8f74daceb4ce58279f7c637d8cb751f.overview: Inspector Jacques Clouseau, smitten with the accused maid Maria Gambrelli, unwittingly turns a straightforward murder investigation into a comedic series of mishaps, testing the patience of his irritable boss Charles Dreyfus as casualties mount.
f8f74daceb4ce58279f7c637d8cb751f.tagline: …the picture that gets away with murder!
